newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Piltel downgraded to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Piltel downgraded to sell.

text.p: Brokerage firm AngPing Securities Inc recommended a sell on Pilipino Telephone Corp on Monday from its previous long-term buy rating.
In a research paper, AngPing said Piltel was operating in a risky environment due to expenses brought about by cloning, or fraudulent calls.

"It is much safer to wait for the effectivity of Piltel's anti-cloning software in the first quarter of next year to see if the cloning threat is truly contained," said Wilfred Son Keng Po, head of sales and research.
Piltel earlier said it expected to incur 300 million pesos in revenue losses this year due to fraud. The cellular phone firm is putting in place anti-fraud systems costing $10 million.
